title: Kavya Reddy v. ABC Hospital
text: The complainant, Kavya Reddy, filed a complaint against ABC Hospital for medical negligence during surgery performed in 2020. The complainant alleged that the hospital's negligence during a routine appendectomy led to serious post-operative complications resulting in a prolonged hospital stay of three months. The NCDRC appointed a medical expert board which found that the complications arose from preventable intra-operative error amounting to medical negligence. Medical negligence by a hospital constitutes deficiency in service under the Consumer Protection Act. The complainant suffered immense physical pain and financial loss. The NCDRC awards compensation of Rs 20,00,000 for pain and suffering, Rs 5,00,000 for additional medical expenses, and Rs 1,00,000 towards litigation costs. The hospital is directed to pay within 60 days. The complainant is entitled to full compensation as ordered.
